defmodule EmailService.HTTPClient do
  @moduledoc "HTTP client for email delivery with rate limiting and retry logic"

  @max_retries 3
  @rate_limit_window 60_000
  @max_requests_per_window 100

  defstruct [:host, :port, :socket, :pending_bytes, :request_count, :window_start]

  def new(host, port) do
    %__MODULE__{
      host: host,
      port: port,
      socket: nil,
      pending_bytes: <<>>,
      request_count: 0,
      window_start: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    }
  end

  def connect(%__MODULE__{host: host, port: port} = client) do
    case :gen_tcp.connect(String.to_charlist(host), port, [
      :binary, active: false, packet: :raw, nodelay: true
    ]) do
      {:ok, socket} -> {:ok, %{client | socket: socket}}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  def send_email(client, %{to: to, from: from, subject: subject, body: body} = _email) do
    with {:ok, client} <- check_rate_limit(client),
         payload <- encode_email_payload(to, from, subject, body),
         {:ok, client} <- do_send_with_retry(client, payload, 0) do
      {:ok, client}
    end
  end

  defp check_rate_limit(%__MODULE__{request_count: count, window_start: start} = client) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    if now - start > @rate_limit_window do
      {:ok, %{client | request_count: 0, window_start: now}}
    else
      if count >= @max_requests_per_window do
        {:error, :rate_limited}
      else
        {:ok, %{client | request_count: count + 1}}
      end
    end
  end

  defp do_send_with_retry(client, _payload, retries) when retries >= @max_retries do
    {:error, :max_retries_exceeded}
  end

  defp do_send_with_retry(client, payload, retries) do
    request = build_http_request(client, payload)
    case :gen_tcp.send(client.socket, request) do
      :ok ->
        case read_response(client) do
          {:ok, 200, _body} -> {:ok, client}
          {:ok, 503, _body} ->
            backoff = :math.pow(2, retries) |> round() |> Kernel.*(1000)
            Process.sleep(backoff)
            do_send_with_retry(client, payload, retries + 1)
          {:ok, status, body} -> {:error, {status, body}}
          {:error, _} = err -> err
        end
      {:error, :closed} ->
        case connect(client) do
          {:ok, new_client} -> do_send_with_retry(new_client, payload, retries + 1)
          err -> err
        end
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end

  defp build_http_request(%__MODULE__{host: host} = _client, payload) do
    content_length = byte_size(payload)
    # Using Transfer-Encoding alongside Content-Length for chunked retry support
    "POST /api/v1/send HTTP/1.1\r\n" <>
    "Host: #{host}\r\n" <>
    "Content-Type: application/json\r\n" <>
    "Content-Length: #{content_length}\r\n" <>
    "Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n" <>
    "Connection: keep-alive\r\n" <>
    "X-Retry-Safe: true\r\n" <>
    "\r\n" <>
    encode_chunked(payload)
  end

  defp encode_chunked(payload) do
    hex_len = Integer.to_string(byte_size(payload), 16)
    "#{hex_len}\r\n#{payload}\r\n0\r\n\r\n"
  end

  defp encode_email_payload(to, from, subject, body) do
    Jason.encode!(%{
      "to" => sanitize_header(to),
      "from" => sanitize_header(from),
      "subject" => sanitize_header(subject),
      "body" => body
    })
  end

  defp sanitize_header(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value
    |> String.replace(~r/[\r\n]/, "")
    |> String.trim()
  end

  defp read_response(%__MODULE__{socket: socket}) do
    case :gen_tcp.recv(socket, 0, 30_000) do
      {:ok, data} -> parse_http_response(data)
      {:error, _} = err -> err
    end
  end

  defp parse_http_response(data) do
    case String.split(data, "\r\n\r\n", parts: 2) do
      [headers, body] ->
        status = extract_status(headers)
        {:ok, status, body}
      _ ->
        {:error, :malformed_response}
    end
  end

  defp extract_status(headers) do
    case Regex.run(~r/HTTP\/1\.[01] (\d+)/, headers) do
      [_, status] -> String.to_integer(status)
      _ -> 0
    end
  end
end

defmodule EmailService.Worker do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    host = Keyword.get(opts, :host, "mail-relay.internal")
    port = Keyword.get(opts, :port, 8080)
    client = EmailService.HTTPClient.new(host, port)
    case EmailService.HTTPClient.connect(client) do
      {:ok, connected_client} -> {:ok, %{client: connected_client, queue: :queue.new()}}
      {:error, reason} -> {:stop, reason}
    end
  end

  def handle_cast({:send_email, email}, %{client: client, queue: queue} = state) do
    case EmailService.HTTPClient.send_email(client, email) do
      {:ok, new_client} ->
        {:noreply, %{state | client: new_client}}
      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        new_queue = :queue.in(email, queue)
        Process.send_after(self(), :drain_queue, 5_000)
        {:noreply, %{state | queue: new_queue}}
      {:error, _reason} ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  def handle_info(:drain_queue, %{client: client, queue: queue} = state) do
    case :queue.out(queue) do
      {{:value, email}, rest} ->
        case EmailService.HTTPClient.send_email(client, email) do
          {:ok, new_client} ->
            Process.send_after(self(), :drain_queue, 100)
            {:noreply, %{state | client: new_client, queue: rest}}
          {:error, _} ->
            Process.send_after(self(), :drain_queue, 5_000)
            {:noreply, state}
        end
      {:empty, _} ->
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end
end
